plan.purpose: broader cross-sectional structural research; no automatic strategy or TDA retuning
plan.universe_rule: top 200 IVV equity holdings by published USD market value descending, ticker ascending ties; active tradable Alpaca us_equity; union original 30; SPY benchmark
plan.holdings_snapshot: downloaded provider snapshot, recorded before price-history collection; must not postdate requested history end
plan.mapping: spaces in provider share-class tickers become dots; verify against Alpaca active asset master; no history-based replacements
plan.share_classes: distinct listed securities retained, including multiple classes of one issuer; not independent issuers
plan.classification: provider sector snapshot, not historical labels; legacy manual groups retained separately
plan.data: SIP 1Day OHLCV, raw and all-adjusted, full pagination; same range as original panel
plan.earlier_history_probe: SPY raw SIP daily bars 2000-01-01 through 2015-12-31; records actual returned availability only
plan.missingness: keep all selected symbols; calendar-aligned blanks; no forward fill, backfill or zero-return substitution; returns require adjacent observed sessions
plan.audit: unique symbol/date, positive finite ordered OHLC, calendar, missing leading/internal/trailing, compounding, prior-panel overlap changes
plan.future_analysis: freeze separate structural design before evaluating expanded-universe outcomes; consider 120-day shrinkage and declared longer-window baseline
limitations: Current survivor/size selection; not a point-in-time historical investable universe.
Fund weight is a size selection proxy, not a measured liquidity guarantee.
Current sector labels and current asset tradability are not historical eligibility.
Adding names does not create independent time histories or restore untouched 2024+ data.
Adjusted returns are a vendor proxy, not an audited action-level total-return ledger.
A longer historical panel is not itself a test of long-run equilibrium mean reversion.
plan.fees: no performance or fee experiment in this collection

earlier_probe_caveat: SPY only, tested dates/feed/account; no global claim about all vendors or symbols
